featured_reviews.review_text: Nidha is amazing at her work!she got me ready for my corporate event of 100 people at Mumbai . i was very clear i want to look like myself and not someone else with heavy makeup,i wanted minimalistic yet classy look ,.she understood my requirements and did exactly what i wanted .i was so happy with my look that at the end of event i didn't want to take off my makeup and hair .i slept whole night with make up on :) i felt beautiful inside out . she came  on time  at 6.30 am both days as getting ready on time was very crucial for me. she is very soft spoken and you can have some good conversation also with her. thats added bonus:) her staff is also very nice and polite . they were fast and got me ready on time as committed . i would highly recommend her services .
